new:process-steps.practice_template: Record one safe process with a numbered step list; ask a viewer to identify any missing step.

new:motion-analysis.title: Compare movement consistently
new:motion-analysis.practice_template: Capture two safe ordinary movements with the same viewpoint; mark observations without giving medical advice.

new:event-backup.title: Rehearse the moment you cannot repeat
new:event-backup.practice_template: Stage a 60-second ceremony or announcement, test sound and record a fallback before any real event.

new:interview-care.title: Ask listen and represent fairly
new:interview-care.practice_template: Agree recording and sharing choices with an adult volunteer; ask an open question and preserve the meaning in an excerpt.

new:creative-brief.title: Make one visual idea work
new:creative-brief.practice_template: State the intended feeling or change; storyboard and compare two versions of a short action.

new:place-observation.title: Observe a place respectfully
new:place-observation.practice_template: Choose a safe permitted location or owned stills. Connect a wide view, distinctive detail and relevant context.

new:creator-brief.title: Make one promise to one viewer
new:creator-brief.practice_template: Write one audience promise; create an opening and ending that answer it without misleading context.

new:commercial-claims.title: Show the benefit truthfully
new:commercial-claims.practice_template: List the claim and the visible evidence needed; make a small owned-product demonstration with any required disclosure.

new:teaching-chunks.title: Teach one objective at a time
new:teaching-chunks.practice_template: Write one learning objective, split the demonstration into steps and test a small learner action with an access alternative.

new:screen-capture.title: Record a readable private screen
new:screen-capture.practice_template: Use dummy data, hide notifications and record a reproducible sequence with legible pointer/text and narration or equivalent captions.

new:live-rehearsal.title: Test the stream and its fallback
new:live-rehearsal.practice_template: Run a private rehearsal, inspect sound and sync at the receiver, simulate an uplink failure and verify the local recording.

new:report-verification.title: Keep facts sources and safety together
new:report-verification.practice_template: Use a fictional harmless incident; log observations separately from accounts and uncertainty, then decide what must remain private.

new:technical-log.title: Make an observation repeatable
new:technical-log.practice_template: Use a safe tabletop proxy, record setup/scale/time, capture a sample and state what the recording cannot establish.

new:archive-preservation.title: Keep originals context and access copies
new:archive-preservation.practice_template: Catalogue an owned sample, keep an unmodified original, label edits, verify a separate copy and document who may access it.

new:aerial-safety.title: Prepare an authorised aerial plan
new:aerial-safety.practice_template: Prepare a ground-based shot map and current authority-check checklist; actual flight remains conditional on permissions and operator competence.

new:spatial-spec.title: Match the geometry and target device
new:spatial-spec.practice_template: Record the target pipeline specification; make a small sample or labelled storyboard and test seams, overlap, comfort or display alignment as relevant.

new:temporal-capture.title: Control change between frames
new:temporal-capture.practice_template: Record a short stop-motion or interval experiment on a stable support, keeping a frame-count and lighting log.

new:accessible-communication.title: Keep the meaning accessible
new:accessible-communication.practice_template: Identify the audience need; produce a short caption, description or signed-communication sample and arrange an appropriate meaning check.

new:consent-privacy.title: Decide what can be recorded and shared
new:consent-privacy.practice_template: Complete a brief permission and privacy plan using fictional data; identify one thing that should stay out of the recording.

new:delivery-originals.title: Check the file and keep the original
new:delivery-originals.practice_template: Check the target file or connection, keep originals where relevant, add context and test access with the intended recipient or a safe proxy.

new:reflect-revise.title: Compare improve and explain
new:reflect-revise.practice_template: Score only what the evidence supports, make one focused improvement and retain the previous version; mark any human review still required.

new:consent-privacy: Identify whose permission or policy applies before capture.
Identify sensitive details and the agreed audience; do not share by default.
Choose a harmless permitted rehearsal and name any professional review still required.
new:delivery-originals: Name the actual recipient, length, orientation and file or connection requirements.
Check legibility and the required caption, description or other access alternative on the receiving device.
Keep a traceable source and a labelled delivery copy with the intended access restrictions.
new:reflect-revise: Separate what was actually observed from claims, simulation or missing evidence.
Show one change addressing a stated criterion without losing required context.
Record the remaining gap and the next practice or qualified review needed.

gear: compatible playback deck or digitisation service
C02-08.variant_task: Identify the original format and use a compatible playback/capture route. Retain the source, log any restoration and compare an access copy without inventing lost detail.

gear: phone or camera with interval capture
C03-09.variant_task: Plan a safe fixed night-sky position, test exposure and log interval and frame count before compiling a short sequence.

C03-10.variant_task: Animate one object across a fixed frame. Count frames, lock framing/light where possible and compare playback at two rates.

C03-13.variant_task: Record an owned gameplay segment with legible UI and clean commentary; check the publisher/platform usage policy and exclude private chat.

C06-06.variant_task: Capture a test plate and the agreed calibration/reference information; have the receiving technical team check alignment and colour assumptions.

C08-03.variant_task: Record a short staff message or test a private call using no confidential material. A screen recording is optional, not a prerequisite.

C11-01.variant_task: Record one harmless drill continuously from a wide view; retain the full sequence and add separately labelled timestamps for a coach.

C12-02.variant_task: Use approved sample footage or a supervised safe specimen. Record scale, exposure, frame timing and uncertainty; do not infer measurements from uncalibrated pixels.

C12-04.variant_task: Use a nonclinical tabletop simulation or explicitly authorised de-identified teaching material. Keep filming instruction separate from clinical technique.

C12-05.variant_task: Use a safe tabletop proxy; real crash or stress tests require the responsible team’s procedure and protected remote recording positions.

gear: location log; drone only when separately authorised
C12-07.variant_task: Use supplied inspection footage or a harmless proxy. Record what can and cannot be seen; do not enter machinery, confined spaces or hazardous sites.

C13-01.variant_task: Use a harmless sample; export the relevant segment with surrounding context without overwriting originals or changing timestamps.

C13-02.variant_task: Practise on staged footage. Record authorised purpose, access and retention decisions, export context and do not claim a surveillance system is lawful from a course score.

C14-01.variant_task: Use dummy information to test a private connection, view and sound. Do not record a consultation by default; any recording needs explicit permission and an approved storage decision.

C16-02.variant_task: Test a small geometry pattern and timed loop against the venue specification; seek operator approval for brightness, alignment and playback safety.

C18-02.variant_task: Build a tiny synthetic-object dataset. Log collection purpose and permissions, label definitions and provenance, prevent subject/sequence leakage across evaluation splits, and review permitted downstream use.

gear: camera or depth capture device suited to target pipeline
C18-05.variant_task: Capture a harmless object’s overlapping views with a scale reference, document settings and test reconstruction against the reference; a pleasing render is not a validated measurement.

gear: accessible branching player or clickable storyboard
C18-06.variant_task: Make two short alternatives and a branch map. Test every destination, a return path and a keyboard-readable equivalent; MP4 clips alone are not a working interactive experience.

C18-07.variant_task: Produce a short test asset for the actual pixel map, aspect, timing and encoding. Verify it with the display operator rather than assuming a universal hologram format.

C18-08.variant_task: Catalogue authentic owned material and the person’s reuse wishes. Any synthetic likeness or voice requires separate explicit permission, clear labelling and a documented decision about future access.
